regime_context: The Hong Kong detector shows a narrow, two-name leadership rotation between Energy (H-shares) and Banks (H + HK), with only 4 of 17 themes eligible on the absolute-trend gate. The headline theme is a durable, broad-based 'trend' in Energy (durability 0.76, breadth 0.80) but every theme in the universe is unscorable except China Tech & Internet and China Platform Megacaps, which are both ineligible and near the bottom of the ranks — so I can only grade ETF-proxy calls on lagging, non-eligible tech themes, and I have no scorable read on the actual leadership. Macro backdrop is dominated by AI-tech and geopolitics headlines with 100% unscheduled news, which is coincident market-level context only.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Banks (H + HK) confirms a handoff from Energy leadership: the rotation margin is only 0.136 with absorption 0.46 and the rotation is marked non-directional, but Banks is eligible with rising rank 2 and crowding_z 1.09 (crowded true). The watch retires when the rotation margin widens above 0.25 in Banks' favor AND the detector flips its directional flag to true — a confirmed handoff, not a prediction of the next narrative.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: The only scorable proxy ETF (3033.HK) maps to the China Tech & Internet theme, which sits at rank 14/17 with a score of -1.065, is NOT eligible on the absolute-trend gate (durability 0.23, hurst_tag 'mean-revert'), has very weak breadth (0.158), and shows negative crowding (-0.91). The trend-gate is the one validated risk-control leg in this market's history (gate_helps=true), and it currently excludes this theme; leaning away from the ineligible, mean-reverting laggard is consistent with drawdown discipline, not a momentum-return forecast.
evidence: gate_helps: true — trend gate is the validated risk-control leg on this market
theses.dissent: Mean-revert tag plus deeply negative crowding could argue for a reversal bounce in oversold tech names, and track-record says low-conviction calls on this desk have historically not missed — but the trend gate's whole point is avoiding shake-outs, and this theme is already out of the gate.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK closes above its 20-day high and the China Tech & Internet theme regains eligibility before the 20-day check-by

theses.subject: China Platform Megacaps
theses.thesis: Second scorable proxy (same ETF, 3033.HK) maps to China Platform Megacaps, which is the single weakest theme in the universe (rank 15/15, score -1.325), ineligible on the trend gate (durability 0.18, hurst 'mixed'), near-zero breadth (0.111), and crowded at -0.87. This is the same underlying ETF as the prior thesis — two themes, one proxy — so the directional lean is identical and should not be double-counted as diversification.
evidence: etf_proxy 3033.HK overlaps with China Tech & Internet thesis
theses.dissent: The overlap with the prior thesis means this adds nothing new; if platform tech benefits from the AI-tech macro narrative dominating headlines, both these underweights could be wrong together.

falsifier.text: 3033.HK outperforms the Hang Seng benchmark by 5% from today before the 20-day check-by

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
